note: Swappable grammar pack (R46, §9.3/§9.11) for the shared-web line. Two namespaces with a machine-checked wall: 'decision' carries every string the player reads WHILE deciding or losing (type labels, terms, refusals, alerts, status-page rungs) and is written SOBER — §9.3 clause 2 bans jokes inside alerts/build-cards/crisis-prompts, clause 3 bans comedy at the moment of loss. 'flavour' carries recognition comedy for quiet surfaces (ticket inbox, trade press, forums, staff chatter, loading tips, stickies, vendor replies, achievements) — the joke is always the situation, never a person, and never a real product (§9.3 recognition-not-parody). §9.11: the business is depicted, never the technique — abuse exists only as complaint/takedown/upstream-pressure text, zero payloads, commands, or exploit paths. Doc-verbatim strings are marked '(verbatim)' in _provenance cites.

eraCodes.1998: The line's founding era as the rendered era axis bites it (bundle availableFrom 2009 is the engine shelf date; §0.4 names the era grid, the two rendered codes follow the sibling era-token pair). Customer lexicon lives and dies here: webmaster, hit counter, FTP, mail form.
eraCodes.2026: Now: the customer is a growth team or an AI-wrapper site, and the ticket arrives mid-stream. Same box, same thin wall between tenants.

site.desc: The customer's website as they name it.

siteCount.desc: Accounts or sites on one box.

customer.desc: Account holder name as it appears on the invoice.

accountName.desc: A person the customer references (developer, son, brother-in-law).

company.desc: Your company, as the industry forum names it.

availableAtTick.desc: Tick at which the queued intent or a freed hand presents.

slotName.desc: Power or card slot designation on a node.

capacityAccounts.desc: Engineered seat count of the box.

accountCount.desc: Generic count of accounts in a cohort or notice.

introPrice.desc: Promo rate locked by the prepay term.

newPrice.desc: Price after the increase or renewal.

termMonths.desc: Months of rate held by an annual-prepay lock.

arrivalCount.desc: Visitors or requests arriving from one fame spike.

replyCount.desc: Depth of a forwarded mail chain.

changedFiles.desc: Files touched in the diff the customer swears they did not author.

changedBy.desc: Account the attached diff is timestamped under.

changedAt.desc: When the change the customer denies making was made.

uploadTime.desc: Timestamp of the FTP session nobody mentions.

weekday.desc: Day of week the emergency was filed on.

filedAt.desc: Clock time a ticket was filed.

victimDomain.desc: Target named in the upstream complaint.

prefix.desc: Your address block cited in the abuse case.

effectiveTime.desc: When a null-route or suspension takes effect.

conglomerate.desc: Roll-up brand on the acquisition ladder.

noticeTotal.desc: How many notices the policy promised.

day.desc: Day of the quarter, for the intern's log.

decision.type.shared-web.name: The Mass Host
decision.type.shared-web.codex: The mass line: thousands of small sites sharing boxes, sold on price, kept on patience. Everything that works here works densely — and fails densely. The customer who is on fire cannot be evicted, because evicting them was never in the margin.
decision.goal.shared-web.binding: One box. Two hundred sites. You cannot evict the customer who is on fire.
decision.scarce.shared-web.qos: The queue is what holds: every visitor gets the next slot in order, and no account buys position on this box.
decision.skin.shared-web.inspector: Cutaway of Cabinet 14 — floors of lit windows, and one of them glowing too bright.
decision.economy.shared-web.bad-month: A slow churn bleed nobody can point at.
decision.verbs.shared-web.transfer.1: Density vs blast radius; one tenant is everyone's problem.
decision.relations.shared-web.mastery: You read the noisy neighbour before the elbow forms; triage decisions land one step earlier on crowded boxes.
decision.relations.shared-web.distillate: Playbook: containment is policy, capacity is arithmetic, and the customer who is on fire stays a customer.
decision.handover.shared-web.runs-out: Slots run out before disk, and your hands run out before either.
decision.handover.shared-web.kills-you: One root on the control panel roots two hundred boxes. The enemy is sometimes a client.
decision.rosetta.shared-web.oversell: Your oversell ratio is the spacing of the teeth on one comb: pack them tighter and the same box 'holds' more sites — until the morning nobody fits.
decision.rosetta.shared-web.density: Tenant density is windows per floor: every lit window is an account sharing a wall with strangers it will never meet.

eras.1998: A link on a famous front page: {arrivalCount} strangers arrive inside the hour and none of them came for your product.
eras.2026: An aggregator lists the site: {arrivalCount} requests a minute arrive as machines, and the humans were never the majority.

scenarios.shared-web.slashdot.fallback: A link on a famous page: {arrivalCount} strangers arrive inside the hour; free traffic, zero conversion, one very awake operator.

decision.scenarios.shared-web.mass-patch-week: Every CMS in the fleet needs the same patch by the same Tuesday; every one you skip is a door you decided to leave open.
decision.terms.oversell-warning: This plan carries {soldAccounts} accounts against {capacityAccounts} engineered seats. The margin is booked today; the contention is a probability you are selling.
decision.terms.prepay-lock: Annual prepay holds {introPrice} for {termMonths} months. Renewal prices at the sheet current on that date — the cliff is in the calendar, not the contract.
decision.terms.price-ladder.2: Aligning our pricing with the value we deliver.
decision.refusal.hands-exhausted: Both hands are committed. The {verb} intent is queued and presents when a hand frees at tick {availableAtTick}.
decision.refusal.stamped-in-future: The {verb} intent is stamped for tick {availableAtTick}, ahead of the current minute. Nothing was spent.
decision.refusal.unknown-node: No board object named {nodeId} exists at the current tick. Nothing was changed.
decision.refusal.edge-exists: A {relationKind} cable already links {nodeId} to those endpoints. The existing edge was left as it is.
decision.refusal.slot-occupied: {slotName} on {nodeId} is occupied. One supplier per socket; disconnect before you reconnect.
decision.alert.incident-start: Elevated error rate on {nodeId}: {affectedAccounts} of {totalAccounts} accounts reporting. Triage begins now.
decision.alert.control-plane-compromise: Control-plane credential exposure on {nodeId}. Treat every account on the box as affected until each is proven clean.
decision.alert.churn-fuse: Cancellation in progress: {customer}. The fuse tripped before renewal; the stated reason is in the ledger.
decision.status.rung-5: We are aware of the fire.

flavour.ticket.subject.urgent-down: URGENT!!! site down (it is not down)
flavour.ticket.body.urgent-down: {site} is DOWN. I checked from my phone three times. My {accountName} says it is a names thing and I pay you people to know about names things.
flavour.ticket.subject.deleted-back: I deleted something, can you get it back
flavour.ticket.body.dev-left: I cannot get into anything. {accountName} set all of it up years ago and does not answer when I call. The site is his work and now the site is your problem.

eras.1998: my hit counter doesnt go up

flavour.ticket.subject.blocklist: please remove my IP from the blocklist I keep spamming from
flavour.ticket.subject.font: can you make the font bigger on my server
flavour.ticket.body.files-deleted: Everything in the website folder is gone and I did not touch it. There has to be a copy somewhere. (Nobody in this thread will say the word FTP until hour three, when {uploadTime} appears in a log excerpt.)
flavour.ticket.subject.bill-up: why did my bill go up
flavour.ticket.body.bill-up: The invoice says {newPrice} where it said {oldPrice}. I did not change anything on the account. (Eleven months ago, in a moment of optimism, backups were switched on.)
flavour.ticket.subject.five-min: I need this fixed in 5 minutes it's very important
flavour.ticket.body.five-min: It has been broken since {weekday} and I am only filing it now, at {filedAt}, because tonight it matters.
flavour.ticket.body.photo: (attached: {photoFile} — a photograph of a monitor, taken at an angle, in low light)
flavour.ticket.body.fwd: See below. (The chain runs {replyCount} deep; no question appears anywhere in it.)
flavour.ticket.body.didnt-change: I didn't change anything. (Attached diff: {changedFiles} files, authored {changedBy}, timestamped {changedAt}.)
flavour.ticket.subject.cancelled-backups: I deleted everything, please restore, I have no backups, also I cancelled backups to save $3.
flavour.ticket.subject.not-notified: I was NOT notified about the maintenance
flavour.abuse.canon.upstream: From: abuse@{upstreamDomain} — Traffic attributed to your block ({prefix}) is causing load at {victimDomain}. Case {caseId}. Respond within {responseHours} hours or the block is filtered at our edge.
flavour.abuse.canon.relay: Complaint {caseId}: {recipientCount} messages were sent from a form on {site} to addresses that did not request them. The customer's contact page is the mail server now. Suspend or confirm.
flavour.abuse.canon.null-route: Transit provider notice: unhandled abuse reports against {prefix} reaching {responseHours} days will result in null-routing of the block effective {effectiveTime}. This is not a negotiation.
flavour.press.headline.obit-chargebacks: LowEndVPS.biz shut down after a chargeback ratio breach.
flavour.press.headline.obit-reit: Northgate Colo sold to a REIT; tenants given 90 days.
flavour.press.headline.acquisition: {acquirer} acquires {acquiredHost}. Statement: "Nothing will change for our customers."
flavour.forum.thread.tier-1: Anyone else seeing packet loss to {company}?
flavour.loading.tip.backup-hypothesis: A backup you haven't restored is a hypothesis.
flavour.loading.tip.backup-rumour: The backup you never restored is a rumour.
flavour.loading.tip.failover: The failover you never tested is not a failover.
flavour.loading.tip.dns-mtu: It is always DNS. Except when it's MTU.
flavour.loading.tip.conduit: Diverse paths that share a conduit are one path.
flavour.loading.tip.monitoring-gap: Every monitoring gap is discovered by a customer.
flavour.loading.tip.two-is-one: Two of something is often one of something.

eras.1998: A box fan in an aisle is not cooling. It is hoping.
eras.2026: A containment aisle is only as cool as the one roof leak above it.

loading.tip.cold-aisle.fallback: Redundant everything except the one shared thing you forgot to count.

flavour.chatter.quiet.label-tape: The label maker ran out halfway through {rackRow}. Masking tape and a marker for the rest of the row — it stays that way all campaign.
flavour.chatter.quiet.amber-led: That amber LED on {nodeId}? It has been 'fine' for two years.
flavour.chatter.cascade.queue: Queue is {queueDepth} deep. Working it top-down; nobody starts anything new on {nodeId} tonight.
flavour.chatter.cascade.status-page: Status page is current. I am writing the next update myself, in plain words.
flavour.canary.notice.window: Scheduled maintenance on {nodeId}, {windowStart} to {windowEnd}: brief interruptions expected. This is notice {noticeNumber} of {noticeTotal}.
flavour.canary.early-cohort: {accountCount} accounts move to the early-image cohort tonight; {metric} is watched for {observationWindow} before the fleet sees anything.
flavour.intern.entry.founding: Day {day}. We host {siteCount} sites and own one label maker. Nobody has slept and nobody has been paged, which I am told means it is going well.
flavour.vendor.reply.firmware: Have you tried updating to the latest firmware?
flavour.vendor.reply.log-bundle: Please collect a full log bundle.
flavour.vendor.reply.known-issue: This is a known issue, fixed in the next release (no ETA).
